items.title: Outbreak of highly contagious infection grows to more than 220 cases
items.description: Federal and state governments have mobilised to address the largest outbreak of diphtheria in recent memory, with the Commonwealth preparing a support package for a disease once considered almost eradicated.

items.title: Australia's costliest disaster recovery program fails to build single home
items.description: A new report finds a disaster recovery program set up after the devastating 2022 floods in northern NSW is yet to deliver any of the homes it promised.

items.title: South Sydney star retires from rugby league due to MND diagnosis
items.description: Rabbitohs and Maroons enforcer Jai Arrow announces he will step away from rugby league after being diagnosed with motor neurone disease.

items.title: Labor walks tightrope as tax overhaul alarms startups and investors
items.description: Labor MPs are gearing up for a hard sell on the impact of the federal government's tax changes on some small businesses, trusts and shares, despite many reporting "positive" feedback on housing reforms.

items.title: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese meets family of Kumanjayi Little Baby
items.description: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese says Australia stands with the family of a five-year-old Aboriginal girl, whose body was found on the outskirts of Alice Springs last month.

items.title: Death of Peter Hollingworth sparks difficult feelings for abuse victim
items.description: Former governor-general Peter Hollingworth, who resigned over his handling of child abuse in the church, died in Melbourne on Tuesday at the age of 91.

items.title: Doctor fined for book of 'WTF' surgery pictures taken without consent
items.description: An anaesthetist who worked at Toowoomba Hospital has been fined $30,000 for professional misconduct after he included confidential patient information in a self-published book.

items.title: Live: Xi and Putin deliver joint statement to media after Kremlin sets 'very serious expectations'
items.description: The two leaders are expected to discuss bilateral economic relations and "key international and regional issues", according to the Kremlin. Follow live.

items.title: Greenland tells US again it is 'not for sale' after Trump envoy talks
items.description: Jeff Landry, appointed by Donald Trump in December as the US special envoy to Greenland, has met the country's prime minister in the capital Nuuk.

items.title: Maldives investigates if Italian divers went too deep in fatal cave dive
items.description: A Maldives government official says a permit was given to study soft corals, but authorities were unaware the group planned to cave dive.

items.title: Married at First Sight UK allegations
items.description: A British network has entirely removed Married at First Sight UK from air and its streaming channel after allegations of rape and sexual assault. The show is widely seen as controversial with accusations it normalises or even platforms toxic relationships. Here's what we know about the allegations so far.

items.title: Australian government calls for detained flotilla members to be released
items.description: The Australian government says it is engaging with Israel over the welfare of 11 Australians detained, as Israeli forces fire "non-lethal" shots at two boats in a Gaza-bound aid flotilla.

items.title: Breaking: Paedophile former magistrate to be released on home detention
items.description: Paedophile and former magistrate Peter Liddy will be released from jail when his sentence expires next month, despite an ongoing application to have him indefinitely detained.

items.title: What life is like as an older parent, or being born to one
items.description: After publishing our story on having babies in your 40s, we heard from readers on what being, or having, an older parent is like.

items.title: The men offering an alternative to 'manosphere' influencers
items.description: "Manosphere" rhetoric is getting louder online, but can men showcasing different lifestyles and values online cut through that noise?

items.title: Teenager Bianca Adler becomes youngest Australian to summit Everest
items.description: A social media post just before 8am AEST announced that Bianca Adler had reached the top of the world's tallest mountain.

items.title: Life on one of the world's most dangerous waterways
items.description: Before rising conflict pushed the Strait of Hormuz into the spotlight as a choke point vital to economies globally, tourism transformed women's lives.

items.title: Teenaged trio arrested over Melbourne nightclub arsons
items.description: Victoria Police allege the three males are responsible for arson attacks at nightclubs La Di Da and Electric Bar earlier this month.

items.title: One killed, four injured in 'brazen, violent attack' inside Sydney home
items.description: A man with links to rap group OneFour has died and four others have been seriously injured following a Canley Heights shooting, which is believed to be organised crime-related.

items.title: Live: ASX falls below 8,500 level as rate rise fears surface
items.description: The Australian share market has fallen below 8,500 points after a US bond sell-off triggered further losses on Wall Street. Oil prices slipped after Donald Trump said he had been an hour away from ordering an attack on Iran before postponing it. Follow live.

items.title: Former NT child protection staff speak out after Kumanjayi Little Baby case
items.description: In the three weeks since the alleged murder of five-year-old Kumanjayi Little Baby in Alice Springs, the NT's child protection system has come under intense scrutiny. Now, former child protection workers are speaking out about why they believe the system is broken.

items.title: Big guns return as Matildas call up teen goalkeeper
items.description: Mary Fowler, Ellie Carpenter and Steph Catley are back in the Matildas squad for games against Mexico, while a teenager has been called up.

items.title: Alcaraz injury woes deepen, former champion out of Wimbledon
items.description: Carlos Alcaraz will miss Wimbledon as he continues his rehab from a wrist injury that has already ruled him out of the French Open.

items.title: Luai and Tigers headline NRL's Las Vegas quartet for 2027 season-openers
items.description: Jarome Luai will begin his final season with the Wests Tigers in Las Vegas, with the NRL unveiling its teams for next year's season-openers.

items.title: Mosque shooting victims hailed as heroes and mourned by community
items.description: Three people killed by two shooters at a San Diego mosque were beloved pillars of the community and died while saving 140 children in the building at the time of the attack, authorities say.
